QuestInfo.name: Pia's Gift
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p201# is ready to return the #t4031064# she borrowed from #p218#.
QuestInfo.1: I finally got my hands on the #t4031064# that #p218# asked for. Now, I just need to bring it back to her.
QuestInfo.2: I delivered the materials needed to make the claw to #p218# in #m10001050# and received a scroll in return. I wonder if #p218#'s friend has already set out on their adventure by now. Who knows? Maybe I'll run into them during my travels!

0.0: Wow! You collected everything...!! Great! Okay then, I will give the #b#t4031064##k back, as promised. Hmm... I liked this cape a lot... Well... a promise is a promise... Take it...!

1.0: Wow! You got everything! Okay. Now I can just give these to #p401# and get the claw. Oh yeah, I'll give you something good, something my mom gave me to only use when I really need it. It will be a lot of help for you.

yes.0: Got it? Thanks for helping me. I hope the scroll will be very helpful. I should hurry and get going to #m10003000#!

npc.0: Oh... You're the one who paid back what #p218# took. How's #p218# doing? When you're in #m10001050#, say hello to #p218# for me.

item.0: Have you brought the item I asked for yet? I need you to get back the #t4031064# I lent to #p201#.

lost.0: Oh my, you lost the #t4031064#? You're lucky, you know. I actually found it while I was out for a walk. Here--make sure you don't lose it again!
